title: Keep bounded reconciliation active after a healthy native watcher
problem: A healthy recursive native watcher returns before starting periodic reconciliation, so a missed native event can leave code-state stale even though watcher events are intended to be invalidation hints.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: A successful recursive watcher remains ready and also schedules bounded periodic reconciliation so missed events can be recovered.
Reconciliation uses the configured interval, stops without post-stop callbacks, and can be started again without leaking a timer.
The qualified Windows path still invokes no native fs.watch backend and retains bounded reconciliation.
Windows Node 24, Ubuntu Node 22/24, macOS Node 24, release checks, and installed-package smoke all pass.
